project.name: NHS Data Sharing
project.graph_query: Which files implement the human wiki, LLM wiki, evidence governance, source register, evidence matrix, validation queue, design contract, Graphify publication, verification, dependency management, local service, and deployment?

formal_conformance.reason: The project predates the candidate and has no .wiki-standard.yaml declaring a DenchCo version, role mappings, capabilities, deviations, or waivers. Capability results below are inferred adoption evidence, not a formal conformance claim.

profile_assessment.declared_legacy_profile: Full / Level 7 (operational) under the Evidence-Linked Knowledge Standard
profile_assessment.summary: The closest and most complete standard-production exemplar in this sample, but it lacks the candidate manifest and security/source-policy set, its OKF output is a custom catalogue rather than proven OKF v0.2, and its published graph runtimes are CDN-hosted.

The sidecar is a custom document catalogue with okfCompatible=true; it has no okf_version, OKF concept metadata, source mapping or unknown-field round-trip proof.
Substantive concepts require checked non-navigation inbound routes including LLM routing.
Queryable repository graph exists and is refreshed by the knowledge update path.
865-node/2,377-edge enriched dataset, checked 2D and force-directed 3D publications.
Named colour, semantic, shape, rail, border and layout tokens have an executable custom check.
Zensical 0.0.51 is exactly pinned and is the only active renderer.
Published graph pages load vis-network 9.1.6 and 3d-force-graph 1.77.0 from unpkg rather than repository-local assets.
Desktop/mobile, graph, focus, deep-link and geometry checks are recorded.
limitations: No repository-pinned Playwright fixture was found and this audit did not replay the historical browser pass.

candidate_false_positive_risks.finding: Accepting okfCompatible=true would wrongly pass a catalogue without OKF v0.2 semantics or round-trip preservation.
Presence of 2D/3D HTML and versioned CDN URLs would wrongly pass the local-runtime requirement.
A prose conformance record should not be treated as a current executable browser result.

candidate_false_negative_risks.finding: Evidence roles live under docs/evidence/ rather than the candidate's root docs filenames; filename-only checks would miss a stronger equivalent.
The project uses an executable custom visual-shape check rather than @google/design.md; dependency-name checks would miss the behaviour.
Read order, ingest/query/lint equivalents and authority are distributed across AGENTS.md and two LLM pages rather than one file.

recommendations: Add a DenchCo manifest that maps the existing stronger role paths and records inferred capabilities without moving files.
Replace the custom OKF catalogue with a validator-backed OKF v0.2 sidecar and unknown-field round-trip fixtures.
Vendor and lock graph browser runtimes, then add an offline/no-CDN browser fixture.
Adopt the standard security, source-retention, copyright and licensing policies by reference or mapped local equivalents.
Add a reviewable candidate-standard diff/upgrade path; do not overwrite local question-led improvements.
audit_limitations: The audit included 25 pre-existing dirty working-tree entries; it describes the inspected working tree, not only git_head.
Graphify query recall was shallow, so graph results were used for routing and corroborated from source files.
Historical browser and CI claims were inspected but not replayed because doing so would regenerate project artifacts.
No external production URL health claim was rechecked in this sub-audit.
